With his signature blend of observational humour, poetry and emotional storytelling, he explores the unspoken sides of fatherhood and the relationship between a father and son.

titles.title: Nalla Padam
titles.synopsis: Kumaran, a man whose entire life revolves around alcohol, is supported by his mother but constantly opposed by his sister and girlfriend, who want him to change. When alcohol lovers form an association and make Kumaran their leader, his life takes an unexpected turn.  Everything changes when the Central Government announces a nationwide ban on alcohol. Forced to survive without his addiction, Kumaran goes to hilarious and desperate lengths to get a drink. Will Kumaran quit alcohol or find a way to continue? What happens to the Association for Alcohol—and to families across India after prohibition? A mix of humour, romance, emotion, mass moments, social message and revolutionary ideas.

titles.title: Amartha
titles.synopsis: After 25 years, village schoolmates reunite to find themselves in vastly different stages of life. Their journey makes them question whether hard work alone determines destiny, or whether an unseen force called Time shapes every fate.

titles.title: Mitti De Putt
titles.synopsis: Two villages are bound by a rivalry that has outlived the men who started it. For one young man, the feud stops being history the day his uncle murders his grandparents and carries his mother away. Left with nothing but the land beneath his feet and the promise he makes on it, he sets out to answer blood with blood. To bring his mother home, he must first confront the man who took her, and the price the soil demands is heavier than he knows.

titles.title: Happy Journey
titles.synopsis: A group of seven women across generations set off on a spontaneous European getaway, leaving their everyday lives behind. Amid the chaos, laughter and picturesque landscapes, the journey becomes an unexpected celebration of freedom and friendship.

titles.title: General Mayhem: The Killing of Brigadier J
titles.synopsis: A young officer is killed inside a general's home. The investigation that followed revealed a cover-up at the highest ranks of the National Police.

titles.title: MANJAR
titles.synopsis: A youthful Marathi family entertainer about friendship, love, family relationships and the unpredictable situations of everyday life, seen through the amusing perspective of an observant cat.

titles.title: The Master and Margarita
titles.synopsis: A struggling writer in 1930s Soviet Moscow finds his life transformed when a mysterious professor arrives with his bizarre entourage, including a wisecracking trickster, a deadly assassin, a vampire maid, and a giant talking black cat, turning the city upside down while exposing the hypocrisy of those in power.

titles.title: Daktar Kaku
titles.synopsis: A doctor and his son follow different ideals while working in their profession, which creates conflict. Whether the two give up their stubborn beliefs and unites for the greater cause of saving humankind will be seen in the film.

titles.title: Without Blood
titles.synopsis: In a frontier landscape at the beginning of the 20th century, gunmen descend on a remote farmhouse, determined to exact revenge. Their target, a doctor — alone with his son and daughter — tries desperately to protect his children. Inevitably, bullets fly.

titles.title: The Scandal
titles.synopsis: In Joseon, a secret proposal ignites hidden desires in a gifted noblewoman, a famed lover and an unsuspecting lady caught in their dangerous game.

titles.title: The Crow Club
titles.synopsis: Four couples form part of the mysterious Crow Club, where supernatural cases and dangerous missions lead to unexpected romantic bonds.

titles.title: JAŸ-Z in 8
titles.synopsis: Thirty years after his landmark debut album, artist, icon, philanthropist, and entrepreneur JAŸ-Z sits down with longtime friend, producer, and director Rick Rubin for an intimate reflection on his storied career.

titles.title: Last Train to Fortune
titles.synopsis: When schoolteacher Cecil Peachtree misses the last train to Fortune, he strikes a deal with outlaw Dooley to secure safe and timely travel.  On the journey, the two develop an odd friendship through the power of knowledge.

titles.title: Beporoya
titles.synopsis: The return of Adrit Roy.

titles.title: Take Off
titles.synopsis: A worker from Northeast China is obsessed with his dream of flying his self-made flying-device.

titles.title: Resident Evil
titles.synopsis: Medical courier Bryan unwittingly finds himself fighting for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.

titles.title: The Condor Daughter
titles.synopsis: Clara is a teenager growing up in a small indigenous community high in the Andes. Her adoptive mother, a midwife who took her in as a baby, has taught her the ancient songs used to guide women through childbirth, melodies passed down for generations, believed to bring new life safely into the world. But while her voice carries on this tradition, her dreams lie elsewhere: she longs to leave the mountains behind and become a folkloric music star in the big city.

titles.title: First They Came for My College
titles.synopsis: When the Governor of Florida transforms a beloved public honors college in a political coup, students and professors confront a new reality: their campus is ground zero in a growing nation-wide assault on academic freedom.

titles.title: Enna Vilai
titles.synopsis: A humble fisherman from Rameswaram lives a quiet life with his family until he finds a gold pendant washed ashore. What initially seems like a blessing soon turns into a nightmare when false accusations threaten his peace and dignity, forcing him to stand up against a powerful system.

titles.title: The Class: Online
titles.synopsis: A group of college students reunite for a late-night online class after the events of The Class. What starts as a normal session begins to feel off when strange glitches and eerie occurrences appear on their screens.

titles.title: Phreaker
titles.synopsis: Inspired by true events. Before there were hackers, there were phreakers. A blind teenager joins the early underworld of "phone freaks" where he learns to hack his way to money, power, and eventually, a place on the FBI's most wanted list.

titles.title: Look At Me!
titles.synopsis: Synopsis TBA

titles.title: Optimus Prime Awakening
titles.synopsis: An animated epilogue to The Transformers: The Movie (1986) and the final performance of Peter Cullen.

titles.title: Thomas & Friends: Really Helpful Engines
titles.synopsis: Around every bend on Sodor, there is someone who needs help and a problem to solve. And no one is more excited to help than Thomas! Join Thomas and his friends for exciting adventures, unexpected surprises, and songs you will be singing long after the journey ends. Because every delivery, every challenge, and every adventure is better when friends work together.

titles.title: Plastic Beauty
titles.synopsis: When a gifted ER surgeon is thrust into cosmetic medicine, her clash with a celebrity doctor exposes the greed and desire beneath the glamour.

titles.title: Monster: The Lizzie Borden Story
titles.synopsis: Trapped in a cruel Victorian-era household, Lizzie Borden kills her parents in a gory ax murder that shocks the nation.

titles.title: The Fixers
titles.synopsis: A washed-up gangster reluctantly teams up with an arrogant political heir to become "fixers", cleaning up dangerous secrets for both sides of the law.

titles.title: Not a Stranger
titles.synopsis: After giving birth, painter Funda put her career on hold to focus on her child. Ready to return to painting, she finally finds the nanny she has been searching for: Nazlı. But the mysterious and increasingly unsettling woman soon begins to disrupt the seemingly peaceful lives of Funda and her husband İlker. What begins as a simple employment arrangement develops into a dangerous psychological game in which desire, secrets and loyalty are put to the test.

titles.title: The Howard Stern Show
titles.synopsis: Each episode spotlights Howard Stern's boundary-pushing humor, social commentary, and intimate conversations – all with his iconic voice and unique perspective. Recognized as one of the best interviewers in the business, the series also features Howard's in-depth, candid conversations with celebrities, musicians, and more.

titles.title: In Her You'll Find Sanctuary
titles.synopsis: After the arrival of a nun with mystical visions, Sister Miriam becomes envious of her rival's sudden notoriety and begins falsifying miracles in a grotesque game of spiritual cat-and-mouse.

titles.title: Brindavihari
titles.synopsis: Brindhavihari is an upcoming Kannada romantic musical entertainer directed by Srinivas Raju.

titles.title: Max vs 100
titles.synopsis: Follows Four-time Formula 1 World Champion Max Verstappen who will take on 100 drivers in a unique go-karting event competition.

titles.title: Golden Axe
titles.synopsis: Legendary warriors Ax Battler, Tyris Flare, and Gilius Thunderhead reunite to save Yuria from the evil giant Death Adder, who just won't seem to stay dead. Their quest is complicated by Hampton Squib, an inexperienced and wildly underprepared adventurer whose dream of heroism far exceeds his abilities. Forced to work together despite their flaws, they must find a way to stop Death Adder once and for all.

titles.title: Neagley
titles.synopsis: Frances Neagley is a private investigator in Chicago and former military colleague of Jack Reacher in the Army's 110th Special Investigations Unit. When she learns that a beloved friend from her past has been killed in a suspicious accident, she becomes hell-bent on justice.

titles.title: The Doll
titles.synopsis: When Stanisław falls in love with the aristocratic Izabela, he dedicates his entire life to winning her over.

titles.title: Minimum Security
titles.synopsis: Corinne runs Chénoise prison with her unlikely team: By-the-book Jeff, JP who's always been closer to inmates than colleagues, and rookie Stéphanie.

titles.title: Unexpected Loves
titles.synopsis: What do a thief, a tennis coach, a nurse, and a tollbooth worker all have in common? Coming from unique plots and a variety of characters, in each episode Martín Bossi plays a different protagonist, someone in search of an unexpected love story.

titles.title: Cathedrals
titles.synopsis: A 17-year-old girl is found burned and dismembered in an empty lot in a middle-class neighborhood of Santiago, Chile. Due to police negligence, the crime goes unpunished until thirty years later, when the family manages to piece together the murder puzzle, revealing a forbidden relationship and a cruel truth.

titles.title: Physical 100: Mexico
titles.synopsis: Reality competition show based on the original Korean format.

titles.title: City of Blood
titles.synopsis: Berlin — a city-state on the brink. While a privileged few live beneath a climate-controlled dome, those outside struggle to survive in a world ravaged by heat, corruption, and crime. After years apart, sisters Bea and Phoebe are reunited and uncover a dark secret: Vampires are determined to seize political power — and blood has become the city's new currency.

titles.title: Route 187
titles.synopsis: Citizens combat urban violence until a bus driver and student's murders by thugs spark outrage, leading authorities to hunt the culprits captured on video.

titles.title: Run Hide Fight: Infidels
titles.synopsis: When radical Islamic terrorists hijack a liberal college's pro-Palestine encampment, a ragtag band of red-blooded students, a security guard, and a Delta Force vet must arm up to save their clueless peers.

titles.title: The World Is A Wedding
titles.synopsis: A teenager joins his grandmother at a mahjong game, where he encounters a mysterious woman threatening to unravel secrets from their family's past.

titles.title: Juan Gabriel: Mi Primer Bellas Artes
titles.synopsis: Mexico’s most iconic concert comes to U.S. theaters on September 15th, celebrating Mexican Independence Day and commemorating the 10th anniversary of Juan Gabriel’s passing. Experience his legendary first performance at Mexico City’s “Palacio de Bellas Artes” in 1990—a landmark event that forever transformed Mexican music. More than three decades later, this historic concert returns in a special theatrical release with newly restored picture and sound, plus an exclusive new opening featuring never-before-seen rehearsal footage from Juan Gabriel’s personal archive that offers a unique glimpse into the making of this unforgettable night. Every song, every standing ovation, and every iconic moment has been revitalized, allowing longtime fans and new audiences to experience this extraordinary performance like never before. Celebrate the timeless legacy of Juan Gabriel on the big screen in this once-in-a-generation cinematic event.

titles.title: P A L A C E
titles.synopsis: New Orleans’ beloved Historic Palace Theatre is set for demolition, when the supervisor behind the project discovers why it closed down from the souls lost inside.

titles.title: Jo Koy: Blue in the Face
titles.synopsis: Jo Koy relives a wild dental disaster, recounts getting fired from McDonald's and celebrates his veteran stepdad in this hilariously heartfelt set.

titles.title: A Very Haunted Renovation
titles.synopsis: Follows six designers living in Bihl Manor for 31 days while completing a renovation. They face elimination challenges testing their nerve and design skills as they transform the haunted mansion's spaces, pursuing a $50,000 cash prize.

titles.title: A Parasite's Heart
titles.synopsis: Bound by an unexpected marriage, Hataya and Ramil are outcasts in their families — but that won't deter them from saving their kin to prove their worth.

titles.title: Destino Maior
titles.synopsis: “Destino Maior” tells the story of Lúcia Cruz, a humble woman who believes she lost her daughter at birth, unaware that the baby was sold by her own stepmother to a wealthy family. Eleven years later, while struggling to support her sick sister and survive life's hardships, Lúcia crosses paths with Matilde, a girl in danger whom she ends up saving. This encounter leads her to Eduardo Ferreira do Vale, the child's adoptive father, who later hires her as his daughter's nanny—unaware that he is bringing mother and daughter face-to-face once again. As the bond between Lúcia, Matilde, and Eduardo deepens, a love story unfolds, shaped by secrets, guilt, and intertwined destinies.

titles.title: Daughters of 9/11
titles.synopsis: Twenty-five years after the deadliest terrorist attack on American soil, Elizabeth Miller, Jessica Trant and FBI special agent Frank Pellegrino confront whether the man accused of masterminding the attacks, Khalid Sheikh Mohammed (KSM), will ever face justice.

titles.title: Gandharva
titles.synopsis: A story that unfolds between dreams and reality, Gandharva is a heartfelt journey of love told through a poetic and cinematic world.

titles.title: A Love Other Than Yours
titles.synopsis: A realistic, emotionally resonant romance about a couple in their tenth year together whose comfortable relationship is tested by unexpected feelings.

titles.title: Vishwanath & Sons
titles.synopsis: A celebrated Olympian shooter travels to America looking for a donor to help his sick child — but unexpected romance complicates his search.

titles.title: Mahendragiri Varahi
titles.synopsis: Siddharth, an atheist and skeptic, is drawn into a mysterious journey surrounding the ancient Varahi temple at Mahendragiri. As he uncovers secrets connected to the sacred site, he is forced to confront forces beyond his understanding, challenging his beliefs and changing his perception of faith, destiny, and the supernatural.

titles.title: Serpent's Path
titles.synopsis: A mysterious woman teams up with a man whose daughter was killed and who is now seeking revenge. Together they kidnap members of an organization and torture them to find out what really happened.

titles.title: Dahaan
titles.synopsis: A malicious ancient spirit is unleashed in a haunted mansion. The girl's elder sister and younger brother team up with a pastor to find a way to end the curse which slowly consumes the girl who opened the box.

titles.title: On a String
titles.synopsis: A young, Juilliard-trained violist is still living at home with her parents in the heart of NYC, while trying to make a living playing gigs with her friends in the homes of strangers.

titles.title: The Fix
titles.synopsis: Disillusioned by the end of the war in Afghanistan, a group of disgraced, war-torn ex-CIA operatives set out to Tehran to take down a life-changing score.

titles.title: Practical Magic 2
titles.synopsis: The Owens sisters must confront the dark curse that threatens to unravel their family once and for all.

titles.title: Ghamasaan
titles.synopsis: A cat-and-mouse tale set in the Hindi heartland, where male friendships and rivalries unveil homoerotic tensions. Men on both sides of the law traverse arid lands, creating a sense of place where unexplored histories reside.

titles.title: Don't Move
titles.synopsis: A church group's annual retreat turns deadly when they wander into the wrong part of the Ozark wilderness, and something starts picking them off one by one.  Suspicion falls on Ricky, the troublemaker of the group. But the real threat is far worse.  Deep in the forest, wrapped in a labyrinth of webs, the group is pursued by a terrifying prehistoric arachnid that hunts by vibration. When every step could be their last, they only have one choice: Don't Move.  It's up to Megan to hold what's left of the group together and get them out alive.

titles.title: Epic - First Semester
titles.synopsis: Rohan, a middle-class student studying abroad due to family expectations, explores romance, identity, and growing up with honesty and emotional depth.

titles.title: Haiwaan
titles.synopsis: A retired judge faces difficulty keeping his daughter safe from a convict he imprisoned. Later, when he gets murdered, a man with visual impairment who was loyal to him tries to defend his daughter.

titles.title: Aasha
titles.synopsis: Follows a stubborn, short-tempered widow named Aasha who gets into a tense altercation with a volatile man named Jeemon following a minor road accident.

titles.title: Singh vs Kaur 2
titles.synopsis: Singh vs Kaur 2 is an upcoming Indian Punjabi-language romantic comedy film directed by Navaniat Singh and produced by Gippy Grewal's Humble Motion Pictures and SVF Entertainment. Serving as a standalone sequel to the 2013 film Singh vs Kaur, it stars Gippy Grewal and Shehnaaz Gill, scheduled for worldwide release on 11 September 2026.

titles.title: Dark Horse
titles.synopsis: Follows Jair Messias Bolsonaro, a man driven by his political career after disappointment with the direction of his country, in the journey to become the 38th president of Brazil.

titles.title: Varavu
titles.synopsis: A family falls victim to the powerful elite in a small town. One man's return forces a confrontation that will expose decades of lies and corruption

titles.title: Pradhama Drishtya Kuttakkar
titles.synopsis: Follows a woman constable who joins the police force through appointment after the death of her husband.

titles.title: Go Team!
titles.synopsis: When their team-building event gets downgraded to a tiny village, a cheese company's staff think it can't get worse — then they learn about the layoffs.

titles.title: HAIRDOO
titles.synopsis: The night before school photos, a spirited young girl attempts to recreate the perfect hairstyle.

titles.title: Last Man in Tower
titles.synopsis: Masterji is a retired schoolteacher whose refusal to go along with those around him places him in direct conflict with his own community. His act of quiet resistance ripples outward, throwing into relief the choices and compromises of neighbors – including Mrs. Puri – as an offer of change tests what each of them is willing to hold on to.

titles.title: If I Go Will They Miss Me
titles.synopsis: A poetic, emotionally expansive father-son story about Black family, grace, imagination, and the hope that love can transform even the most fragile relationships into something more healing and beautiful.

titles.title: Maharaja Hostel
titles.synopsis: A group of college students settle into what seems like an ordinary hostel, but things soon take a strange turn when a series of unexplained incidents begin to unfold. As their fun-filled hostel life descends into chaos, the students and their warden are forced to face the mysterious presence lurking within Maharaja Hostel.

titles.title: Rakkasapuradhol
titles.synopsis: Inspector Shiva an alcoholic officer struggling with schizophrenia, is transferred to Rakkasapura, a seemingly quiet village with a low crime rate. Soon The village’s peace is shattered by a series of gruesome murders. Young women are found dead, dressed in bridal finery with their faces charred beyond recognition. Witness as a troubled cop in rural India confronts his own demons while pursuing a complex case that tests his moral boundaries and beliefs.

titles.title: Vengeance
titles.synopsis: Vengeance follows a young woman with a mysterious past that slowly comes to light. Driven by an unrelenting purpose, she transforms into someone capable of crossing any boundary to fulfill her mission. Each obstacle she faces only sharpens her resolve, pulling her deeper into a ruthless path.

titles.title: Video
titles.synopsis: Video is a found footage, Docudrama by Srinidhi Bengaluru that stars Dheekshith Shetty, Bharatha, Jeevan Shivakumar, Tejesh S M, Priya J Achar, Nalme Nachiyar.

titles.title: Top
titles.synopsis: Finally at the hospital for his long awaited gender affirming top surgery, Matt Levit, with lively girlfriend Leisha Meyer by his side, navigates the bureaucracy of the top surgery process. But once Matt is thrown deep into surgery day, he suddenly finds his present intertwining with his past self, Kimberly. Plunging through past and present, Matt is dropped into confronting his relationship with his chest and sudden loss of his mother, Nancy.

titles.title: Precipice
titles.synopsis: A reckless group of teens on the run from the ever approaching future engage in a downward spiral of drug abuse, violence, and existentialism.

titles.title: Gator Face
titles.synopsis: A Florida vacation becomes a blood-soaked fight for survival when a group of friends are hunted through the swamps by a savage cult that feeds its victims to ravenous alligators in the name of an ancient reptilian god.

titles.title: Hanuman Ansh
titles.synopsis: A grieving boy seeks God to meet his departed mother, and in finding the divine, learns to serve humanity with miracles of love, food and silent blessings, becoming Hanuman Ansh, Neem Karoli Baba.

titles.title: Blood Moon
titles.synopsis: Across a single night, a ghost and a vampire drift through a haunting, music-driven meditation on belonging, finding love, tragedy and resurrection in a living–dying–living world.

titles.title: Vivaah
titles.synopsis: A beautiful, smooth-paced family drama, "Vivaah" is the story of four women and their life's struggles.

titles.title: America America 2
titles.synopsis: America America 2 is an upcoming Kannada romantic entertainer film directed by Nagathihalli Chandrashekhar. The film stars Nirup Bhandari, Pruthvi Ambaar, and Shanvi Srivastava in the lead roles.

titles.title: Fanny
titles.synopsis: The ambitious hairdresser Fanny must survive within the demanding world of the Viennese court. When she pays no mind to the existing rules and moralities of the time, she draws the unexpected attention of the Empress, as well as a public audience.

titles.title: Jayanti 2
titles.synopsis: When a tribal girl, Payal, is suspended from college for protesting discrimination by her classmates, Santya and Tanuja team up to fight college politics, political pressure, and social ignorance in order to restore her dignity and secure her return.

titles.title: Tribeca 25
titles.synopsis: 25 years after 9/11, discover how Robert De Niro and Jane Rosenthal transformed an ambitious effort to revive Lower Manhattan into one of the world's leading cultural institutions. Through rare archival footage, exclusive interviews and behind-the-scenes access, explore how art can foster community, confront injustice, and help shape culture.

Through rare archival footage, exclusive interviews and behind-the-scenes access, explore how art can foster community, confront injustice, and help shape culture.

titles.title: Pidha Pachhi...
titles.synopsis: A spontaneous trip takes four friends down a wildly unexpected path after a drunken night ends in missing memories, accidental crimes and nonstop chaos. As they retrace their steps, every discovery makes their hilarious situation even worse.

titles.title: Mighty Mary
titles.synopsis: Mighty Mary chronicles an amazing group of “we eat nails for breakfast” type of women: the first all-women’s sailing team to contend for the famed America’s Cup, the holy grail for one of sport’s most elite and exclusive racing events.  This team was groundbreaking, beginning with an advertisement in the New York Times.  From there, a group of world class and Olympic sailors as well as Olympic rowers came together, a team which included a deaf sailor, a Native Hawaiian sailor, and the first African American sailor to ever win an America’s Cup race (as a coach of this novice, erstwhile team).  What was dismissed as a publicity stunt turned into something unimaginable. This motley crew (sailing aboard Mighty Mary) stunningly eliminated Stars & Stripes from contention. However, a secret backroom deal the night before the race upended that result. This is a true underdog story about a team which reshaped what could be possible in a sport that had long been inaccessible.

titles.title: Ghun Gaon
titles.synopsis: Shanaya, a wildlife photographer, travels alone to the remote village of Ghun Gaon to photograph a rare black leopard. However, she soon discovers a far more sinister and unsettling presence lurking deep within the jungle.

titles.title: Ozhiyathe
titles.synopsis: In August 1976, 19 schoolboys from Koduvayoor were arrested without cause and tormented for 21 days under the Emergency. Ozhiyathe brings this unrecorded true story of injustice and resilience finally to light.

titles.title: Adkitta
titles.synopsis: A babysitter's unexpected stay transforms a family's life and relationships.

titles.title: Barood
titles.synopsis: Barood is a story of today's youngsters being exploited by corruption. Jui, an innocent girl, falls in love with a loafer Shaon. And this turns Shaon's life upside down. The lovebirds wish to live a fairytale life but the circumstances are against them. In the race between love and society - who wins?

titles.title: Cosmic Symphony
titles.synopsis: Four iconic instruments, including The Wizard of Oz and A Star Is Born pianos, all lost in the 2025 Los Angeles Fires, are celebrated by their musicians, culminating in an animated send-off towards an imagined future, a Cosmic Symphony. Directed by Oscar-nominated composer Laura Karpman, and featuring John Clayton, Susie Chung, Starr Parodi and Diane Warren, Cosmic Symphony explores a truth that every musician knows - musical instruments have souls.

titles.title: The Revolutionaries
titles.synopsis: The Revolutionaries narrates the inspiring tale of brave young Indian freedom fighters who fought for ending British Raj with their unwavering spirit and ideology.

titles.title: The Trial
titles.synopsis: A teenager and her father struggle for justice after she is sexually assaulted by the scion of a successful businessman. Not only will the father and daughter have to navigate a failed judicial system, but they must also contend with a wealthy adversary bent on using all his power to protect his son.

titles.title: Honor Thy Mother
titles.synopsis: After years of estrangement, a mother and daughter find themselves on opposite sides of a bitter contest for what each believes is rightfully hers. Old wounds resurface as they weigh whether to confront the past together or let it drive them further apart.

titles.title: Operation Deception
titles.synopsis: Follows a controversial undercover operation that sent Alain Olivier, a drug-addicted Quebec forestry student, to death row in Thailand in 1989.

titles.title: Physical 100: Italy
titles.synopsis: One hundred Italian athletes face brutal physical challenges, each battling to outlast the rest and claim the glory of becoming the one true champion.

titles.title: Ali Baba Aur 40 Bhoot
titles.synopsis: Rooted in logic and science, Alisha is drawn into an experience that defies everything she believes. Will she find answers or uncover a terrifying truth?

titles.title: Stolen Heartbeats
titles.synopsis: After an attack leaves a woman named Anabel comatose, she and Rafael—a nurse who has the unique ability to hear the dead—must work together to keep her alive while hiding from her enemies.

titles.title: The Pandemic Prophet
titles.synopsis: When Professor Didier Raoult promotes a "miracle cure" for COVID-19, six ordinary citizens go after the truth -- including his own daughter.

titles.title: Sardar 2
titles.synopsis: When the mysterious Black Dagger threatens national security, Inspector Vijay embarks on his most dangerous mission yet. As the battle unfolds, the extraordinary origin of legendary spy Sardar is finally revealed, uncovering the sacrifices that forged a legend and the secrets that could shape the future.

titles.title: Mandaadi
titles.synopsis: A fishing captain applies his maritime knowledge in a traditional boat race along Tamil Nadu's coast during a festival, leading a six-person team against other crews.

titles.title: Maremma
titles.synopsis: In a village bound by ancient traditions, the Maremma Goddess festival is a time of both reverence and fear. Every 12 years, a male bull is sacrificed to the deity, yet with each ceremony, calamity befalls the villagers. Despite their efforts, the elders fail to prevent disaster. Determined to break the cycle, they enact a new decree: any household whose bull bears a male calf in the next 100 days must offer it to the goddess. As the deadline approaches, the fate of the village hangs in the balance, and the true test of their resolve begins.

titles.title: Norton Creek Massacre
titles.synopsis: It's 1998. Deep in the pine forests outside a sleepy North Carolina town in Norton Creek, A loner has spent his whole life dreaming of being a killer. His only real friend is Dron, a towering, near silent, monstrous juggernaut. Together they cause destruction on locals, and a group of vampires passing by.

titles.title: The Uprising
titles.synopsis: As war and plague devastate 14th-century England, a humble peasant ignites a rebellion, uniting an army of commoners to defy the King’s might in a desperate fight for justice and survival.

titles.title: The Ordinary Jackpot
titles.synopsis: An ordinary office worker wins the lottery – the amount isn't enough for him to quit his job, but it's enough to give him a new outlook on life.

titles.title: Crew Girl
titles.synopsis: After a family scandal, teen rower Teagan Tao moves to a small town and joins an elite prep school's all-boys crew, sparking rivalry and attraction.

titles.title: Chumbak
titles.synopsis: Five quirky families navigate life as neighbors in Chumbak Colony, where chaotic conflicts and hilarious antics turn each day into a new chapter.

titles.title: The Perfect Lie
titles.synopsis: When one of their own is killed in a house fire, four picture-perfect couples are forced to question everything they thought they knew about each other.

titles.title: LOL Next
titles.synopsis: Spin-off of the hit series "LOL: Last One Laughing", hosted by Hazel Brugger.

titles.title: A Killer Story
titles.synopsis: Investigative journalist Joe Sexton looks into a 2002 double homicide case in Kansas after receiving thousands of emails from Eileen Umbehr, a homemaker turned citizen sleuth. Eileen and her husband Keen are convinced that Dana Chandler, the woman accused of killing her ex-husband and his girlfriend, did not commit the crime and devote their lives to fighting for Chandler's innocence.

titles.title: Hope
titles.synopsis: In the remote South Korean village of Hope Harbor, police chief Bum-seok and officer Sung-ae are called to investigate a mysterious creature wreaking havoc on the community. But all is not as it seems, and perceptions can be misleading. What begins as ignorance plants the seed of disaster, escalating through human conflict into a tragedy of cosmic proportions.

titles.title: Drawn Together
titles.synopsis: Marfil, daughter of a powerful Spanish businessman, sees her life in New York turned upside down when she is kidnapped and released without explanation. Her father hires Sebastian Moore as bodyguard and, forced to spend every minute together, an inevitable attraction ignites in a world where nothing is as it seems.

titles.title: Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger
titles.synopsis: Experience the meteoric rise of Oasis through rare footage and untold stories as the band reunites for Oasis Live '25, chronicling their journey from Manchester streets to global rock stardom.

titles.title: Band of Brothers: Legacy
titles.synopsis: This tribute to the groundbreaking series that helped preserve the story of Easy Company and deepened public appreciation for the sacrifices of the Greatest Generation features new interviews with cast members Damian Lewis, Ron Livingston, Michael Cudlitz, Capt. Dale Dye, USMC (Ret.), David Schwimmer, and more. Through personal reflections and behind-the-scenes stories, participants revisit the experience of making the series and explore its lasting cultural resonance, and also includes never-before-seen archival footage and photographs of Easy Company and World War II.

titles.title: Last Seen
titles.synopsis: When emergency dispatcher Ian Ridley receives a frantic call from a teenager he believes could be his long-missing daughter, he stops at nothing to find her.

titles.title: Family Full House with Rohit Sharma
titles.synopsis: Family Full House with Rohit Sharma features Indian cricketer Rohit Sharma making his television hosting debut on Sony TV. The family-focused game show brings competing families together for fun, survey-based trivia infused with Rohit's signature laid-back wit and humor.

titles.title: Why Did I Get Married Again?
titles.synopsis: The couples reunite for the destination wedding of Marcus and Angela's daughter, bringing drama old and new as they ask, "Why did we get married again?"

titles.title: Stavros Halkias: Uncle Stav
titles.synopsis: In this unruly set, Stavros Halkias imagines becoming a "dirtbag" uncle, roasts the health care system and warns of the risks of living your best life.

titles.title: Untold Mr. T: I Pity the Fool
titles.synopsis: Before the gold chains, mohawk, and Hollywood fame of The A-Team and Rocky III, there was Laurence Tureaud. This is the extraordinary origin story behind one of the most unlikely and beloved icons in entertainment — Mr. T.

titles.title: Biff the Human Slayer
titles.synopsis: A delusional vampire takes it upon himself to rid his town of violence. To do so, he teams up with a couple of freshly turned vampires, a stubborn christian struggling to adjust to his new truth, and a rook who is quick to adapt to hers.

titles.title: The Drop: A Snowfall Saga
titles.synopsis: In 1990s Los Angeles, Wanda and Leon fight to take West Coast rap mainstream while gang wars erupt and record labels move to exploit hip hop culture for their own gain.

titles.title: Dang!
titles.synopsis: After their sister Ruthie blows up her perfect life, Andrew and Eunice show her the fun in being flawed as she helps them adult.

titles.title: Bobby Flay’s The Line
titles.synopsis: Chef Bobby Flay is pulling back the curtain on the high-stakes realities of working on a restaurant line. In the new competition series, we get to watch Bobby lead his hand-picked home team of extraordinary chefs — Antonia Lofaso, Michael Jenkins and Claudette Zepeda — against some of the country’s most acclaimed restaurant staffs. These dueling lines must execute a flawless dinner service for real diners in real time. If the visiting restaurant team prevails, they'll win $25,000.

titles.title: Runner
titles.synopsis: A former soldier is thrown into a brutal race against time when a critical medical delivery makes him and his unlikely partner the targets of a ruthless cartel. As the mission spirals into a deadly manhunt, every detour, delay, and bullet pushes them closer to failure. With betrayal closing in from every side, they must survive the chase and deliver their cargo to save the life of a little girl.

titles.title: Wild Tamil Nadu
titles.synopsis: Wild Tamil Nadu is a spectacular new natural history film that reveals the extraordinary biodiversity of Tamil Nadu- a land where rainforests, reefs, and deserts meet in one of the most unique ecological landscapes on Earth.

titles.title: 26F Seeking Friend
titles.synopsis: After posting on Reddit looking for a best friend, a lonely, socially awkward woman interviews a series of potential new friends.

titles.title: The Hooters Murders: Deadly Shift
titles.synopsis: Between 2001 and 2010, separated by thousands of miles, the victims shared one connection: they were all associated with Hooters. The Hooters Murders: Deadly Shift is a two-hour documentary that unravels these tragic murders, exposing how young women who were linked to the iconic restaurant chain were preyed upon.

titles.title: Parched
titles.synopsis: When the water runs out during the journey.

titles.title: OJ Unseen: Exploitation of Evil
titles.synopsis: A decade after O.J. Simpson was controversially acquitted of the murders of his ex-wife Nicole Brown Simpson and her friend Ron Goldman, he attempted to rebrand himself as a reality TV star with the hidden camera prank PPV special Juiced.

titles.title: Collision
titles.synopsis: When business magnate Miguel Ángel dies in a mysterious crash, his daughter Zoé and estranged wife Belén fight for control of his company.

titles.title: Fan Level Midnight: Devoted to The Office
titles.synopsis: Explore how the U.S. version of The Office grew from a ratings-challenged adaptation to one of the most enduring television series of its era. Traveling from the home of Dunder Mifflin in Scranton, Pennsylvania, to the soundstages in Van Nuys, California, the filmmakers also turn the camera toward the fans themselves.

titles.title: Cocaine
titles.synopsis: "Cocaine" is a gripping crime thriller that delves deep into the murky intersection of law enforcement and criminality. Set against the vibrant yet perilous backdrop of Mumbai, the story revolves around a powerful drug cartel that wields significant control over the cocaine trade with the connivance of corrupt police officials and politicians. Abhimanyu Singh stars as Jalal, a diligent police inspector who finds himself entangled in the cartel's sinister web. Despite his best efforts to stay above board, Jalal must go to extreme lengths to protect his own brother, who is targeted by the ruthless cartel. As Jalal navigates the perilous dualities of upholding the law while safeguarding his family, he becomes ensnared in a dangerous game of survival.

titles.title: The Kevin Langue Show
titles.synopsis: Kevin Langue and his friends put their people-reading skills to the test, questioning a lineup of contestants to try and find the secret liar.

titles.title: KL2
titles.synopsis: Kevin Langue and his friends turn childish games into pure, chaotic fun.

titles.title: The Yellow Elephant
titles.synopsis: A documentary on human–elephant conflict

titles.title: Dark Matter
titles.synopsis: Jason Dessen is abducted into an alternate version of his life. To get back to his real family, he embarks on a harrowing journey to save them from the most terrifying foe imaginable: himself.

titles.title: Mayday
titles.synopsis: When a U.S. Navy pilot on a top-secret mission during the Cold War gets trapped behind enemy lines, his only chance at survival is to form an alliance with an eccentric ex-KGB agent.

titles.title: Silo
titles.synopsis: In a ruined and toxic future, thousands live in a giant silo deep underground. After its sheriff breaks a cardinal rule and residents die mysteriously, engineer Juliette starts to uncover shocking secrets and the truth about the silo.

titles.title: Fuze
titles.synopsis: An unexploded WWII bomb is discovered on a busy construction site in the centre of London. Chaos ensues as the military and police begin a mass evacuation against a ticking clock.

titles.title: Puratawn
titles.synopsis: Ritika and Rajeev visit her ancestral house in Konnagar to attend her mother's 80th birthday celebration, only to discover her mother's deteriorating mental state, forcing Ritika to confront this difficult reality and its permanence.

titles.title: Signal One
titles.synopsis: A computer scientist is invited by a tech billionaire to join his private facility on a Caribbean island to investigate extraterrestrial matter on Earth. When they make contact beyond our world, chaos erupts as we’re left to wonder: do they come in peace?

titles.title: The Court
titles.synopsis: The Court is an American legal drama television series that aired from March 26 until April 9, 2002.

titles.title: C.O.G.
titles.synopsis: A pioneering tech startup is on the verge of launching COGN-AI-TIVE — a new AI chatbot with unparalleled speed and intelligence. Soon, the team discovers that their creation harbors a dark and sinister will of its own.

titles.title: Onslaught
titles.synopsis: When a rogue squad of genetically engineered super soldiers break loose in the desert, a badass Army sniper must unleash hell to protect her young daughter.

titles.title: Come with Me
titles.synopsis: Working-class Simon Ward's life unravels after a traumatic home invasion, mounting problems at work and the loss of his best friend. Falling under the influence of rhetoric-spewing radio host Dalton Kirby, Simon spirals into a violent attempt to correct the injustice he believes surrounds him.

titles.title: By Any Means
titles.synopsis: In 1960s Mississippi, a young Black FBI agent is forced to partner with a notorious mafia hitman to investigate a wave of brutal civil rights murders.

titles.title: Winkle Twinkle
titles.synopsis: An idealistic political activist returns to a world that has changed beyond recognition, forcing him to confront the clash between his long-held beliefs and modern realities. Torn between family, ideology, and his own sense of identity, he embarks on a deeply personal journey of self-discovery and change.

titles.title: cocoon - One Summer of Girlhood
titles.synopsis: San and Mayu attend an all-girls school on a warm and tranquil island. When war reaches their shores, they are ordered to help nurse the wounded in a military hospital hidden away in a cave. Amidst escalating death and brutality, the friends struggle to find solace in their fragile lives.

titles.title: Ernie & Emma
titles.synopsis: A pear salesman is left with some amusing duties and an urn of ashes after losing the love of his life.

titles.title: Tom and Jerry: Forbidden Compass
titles.synopsis: During a chase inside a museum, Tom and Jerry find an ancient magical compass and end up being transported through time. Lost in a distant era, they will need to work together to find a way back home.

titles.title: Immortal
titles.synopsis: An unsuspecting man finds himself at the center of a series of mysterious deaths, forcing him to confront a truth that could cost him everything.

titles.title: Sahaa - Life of Sanju
titles.synopsis: Sanju's journey from childhood to adulthood takes an emotional turn when he meets a young woman named Sahaa, whose presence awakens nostalgic memories from his past.

titles.title: The Girl in the River
titles.synopsis: A seasoned criminologist and a young female psychologist are lured to a remote Mississippi town to investigate the murder of a little girl and the disappearance of her twin sister.

titles.title: 4 Idiots
titles.synopsis: King, Queen, Jack, and Ace-four misfits surviving through petty crimes in Chennai-found their world turned upside down when COVID-19 lockdowns shut down public transport, their main source of income. Desperate for a way out, King discovered an audio recording about a bungalow filled with black money, supposedly guarded by a lone watchman. Seeing it as their golden opportunity, the gang set out to execute the perfect heist. However, upon entering the bungalow, the door slammed shut behind them, and a chilling voice welcomed them. The so-called security guard was none other than Pulibaba, a notorious gangster. With a gun in hand, he forced them to surrender their belongings and made a sinister phone call: "Doctor, the delivery is ready... Eight kidneys.

titles.title: Ramba Oorvasi Menaka
titles.synopsis: A man spends 15 years attempting to use a magical book to summon the celestial angels Ramba, Urvasi, and Menaka to earth, but Lord Indra blocks their descent until they finally arrive.

titles.title: Lau Chu Hoa: The Deadliest Mansion
titles.synopsis: In the early 20th century, the daughter of a wealthy family in Saigon met a tragic end in the family's grand estate. Though her death was officially declared as an accident, the rumors of a woman in white, seen weeping by the old window of the mansion late at night, begin to spread.

titles.title: Barbara Forever
titles.synopsis: An archive-driven exploration of the life, work, and legacy of iconic, pioneering lesbian filmmaker Barbara Hammer.

titles.title: Chronovisor
titles.synopsis: A French academic is seduced into a world of untold histories in her scholarly quest to uncover the mystery of a history-capturing camera-like machine created by clandestine Benedictine monks. An academic-noir, armchair mystery in the lineage of Jorge Luis Borges and Umberto Eco.

titles.title: Dilemma
titles.synopsis: The film follows Shravani Manohar Naik, a 35-year-old Indian woman living in the United States, whose life is shaped by a childhood trauma-the acidental death of her mother at age six. Since then, her father Manohar has been her emotional anchor, bound by a promise to never leave each other alone. Now married and pregnant after two miscarriages, Shravani's current pregnancy is her last chance at motherhood. During her fourth month, she abruptly returns to her hometown of Vasai, sensing something is wrong. Her fears are confirmed when she learns her father is terminally ill, with only months to live.  Devastated, Shravani longs to stay with him, but her husband insists she return to the US to secure their child's future. Caught between love, duty, and loss, Shravani must choose between honoring a lifelong bond and protecting the life growing within her, confronting the most paintul crossroads of her life.

titles.title: Dear You
titles.synopsis: Xiaowei travels to Thailand to find his "billionaire grandfather" who is out of contact due to debt problems, but unexpectedly find the one who has been corresponding with his grandmother for years is not her husband.

titles.title: Delivery Boy
titles.synopsis: A young food delivery rider, who dreams of becoming a police officer, is forced to steal money to save his critically injured mother. Months later, when he discovers that the same man has been falsely accused of murder, he risks everything to save the life he once unknowingly changed forever.

titles.title: Bhootu Aaya Bhago
titles.synopsis: Three friends find themselves trapped in a series of mysterious and supernatural incidents inside a hospital.

titles.title: Bol Bhavein Na Bol
titles.synopsis: A boy and girl meet by chance. Their quiet connection grows into love as they learn the most profound feelings need no words. Grounded in innocence, hope, and life's simple beauty, it honors love that's felt beyond expression.

titles.title: Dhurandhar: The Fall
titles.synopsis: After a major accident leaves him injured and confined to his home for months, a young guy named Dipansh is forced to face pain, isolation, and uncertainty.  With little support around him, he begins navigating his recovery largely on his own, while confronting the unexpected actions of those he once called friends.  What begins as a physical fall slowly becomes a much deeper battle within.  A documentary short film by himself.

titles.title: The Anchoress
titles.synopsis: In the Middle Ages, a young woman pursues holy solitude in the wild -- but when a horrifying trespasser emerges from the woods, she must fight for her life.

titles.title: Instadocs: The Decoy Plane
titles.synopsis: A critical threat. A clandestine escape. And a Turkish catering truck? With firsthand accounts, "Instadocs" digs into what happened aboard Air Force One.

titles.title: Yen Ennai Edho Seidhai
titles.synopsis: Broken young man trapped in emotional darkness finds unexpected healing when Madhu's love guides him from self destruction toward hope, purpose, and light.

titles.title: Dhamaal 4
titles.synopsis: The Dhamaal boys are back for another treasure hunt, facing hilarious challenges in their quest for the Treasure of Life.

titles.title: Earle Meets World
titles.synopsis: Alix Earle, Gen Z's ultimate "It" girl, gets real in this unscripted, unfiltered series that goes behind the scenes of her life and family.

titles.title: G.D.N.
titles.synopsis: G.D. Naidu overcomes challenges and defies a repressive colonial regime to become one of India's greatest innovators.

titles.title: Korean Kanakaraju
titles.synopsis: Possessed by a Korean spirit, Kanakaraju must navigate his new supernatural identity to protect his family and solve the spirit's murder.

titles.title: A Minecraft Movie
titles.synopsis: Four misfits find themselves struggling with ordinary problems when they are suddenly pulled through a mysterious portal into the Overworld: a bizarre, cubic wonderland that thrives on imagination. To get back home, they'll have to master this world while embarking on a magical quest with an unexpected, expert crafter, Steve.

titles.title: Teenage Wasteland
titles.synopsis: Inspired by an unconventional teacher, a group of teenagers in upstate New York in the early 1990s make a student film and uncover a vast conspiracy that is poisoning their community. Thirty years later, they revisit their film and confront the legacy of this transformative experience.

titles.title: Jagamae Sangeetham
titles.synopsis: Set in Vaikuntapuram, a sacred temple town nestled between the banks of the Godavari and the neon lights of pop stardom, a disciplined heir to a musical throne and a fame-weary singer strike a forbidden chord. To protect a century of heritage, they must navigate a landscape of family secrets, masked identities, and the heavy price of finding their own voices.

titles.title: Parasomnia
titles.synopsis: After her friend vanishes, Riley must confront the demon from her night terrors that may have crossed into reality, while facing her own tragic past.

titles.title: Unmadham
titles.synopsis: Haunted by his past, a police constable reopens an unsolved cold case. As hidden secrets surface, he must confront truths that challenge his beliefs forever.

titles.title: The Grand Tour
titles.synopsis: Welcome to The Grand Tour. The world's greatest motoring show reboots with new presenters - Thomas Holland, James Engelsman and Francis Bourgeois - and its trademark blend of global adventure, incredible vehicles, epic stunts and strong opinions.

titles.title: On Campus: Game of the Week
titles.synopsis: Every week at a different school, go inside campus life with real college students from the lead-up to the aftermath of college football's biggest games.

titles.title: Jeevan Bheema Yojana
titles.synopsis: Jeevan and Yojna are a couple drowning in debt who hatch an insurance scheme after crossing paths with Bheema, a stranger who bears a striking resemblance to Jeevan - but things spiral out of control when he turns out to be tangled up in a diamond smuggling racket.

titles.title: Mahaprabhu Jagannath
titles.synopsis: In Kaliyug, the evil asur Aham traps devotees in a mercury-made world, but their faith in Jagannath never breaks. Guided by young Balram's devotion, Mahaprabhu Jagannath defeats Aham through divine wisdom and frees all, proving that true bhakti always triumphs over ego.

titles.title: Mirzapur: The Movie
titles.synopsis: The battle for Mirzapur’s throne intensifies as old enemies resurface and a new threat emerges in the form of Babban Babua, a ruthless businessman from Jaisalmer with ambitions of his own. As the Tripathis face enemies from both the past and present, loyalties are tested while Guddu and Bablu Pandit fight to establish themselves in the power struggle for Mirzapur.

titles.title: Mayday
titles.synopsis: When a U.S. Navy pilot on a top-secret mission during the Cold War gets trapped behind enemy lines, his only chance at survival is to form an alliance with an eccentric ex-KGB agent.

titles.title: I'm Game
titles.synopsis: A fearless gambler who trusts luck more than life gets caught in a series of crazy and unexpected events that turn his world upside down.

titles.title: Gandhari
titles.synopsis: When a mother loses her eyesight and her daughter in a kidnapping, she takes matters into her own hands to hunt down those responsible.

titles.title: The Runner
titles.synopsis: Maia Marten, a brilliant London lawyer, has her life shattered by a single call on her morning run: her son has been taken. To get him back, she must keep running, obey every ruthless command, and trust no one-each second a test of how far a mother will go to save her child.

titles.title: Clash of the Thundermans
titles.synopsis: When Chloe develops a destructive new superpower, the Hero League orders her to an elite boarding school for superheroes to learn control of her abilities. Faced with the prospect of sending Chloe away for years, the Thundermans split apart, with Phoebe, Barb and Billy taking her into hiding. Max, Hank, and Nora track their rogue family members, until the two factions face off against each other in a full-on battle for the Thundermans’ future.

titles.title: Romanchakam
titles.synopsis: A cocky engineering grad starts a dating app to prove he can succeed at anything. But a mysterious online connection turns his world upside down. Between a failed startup, money trouble, and crazy moments with his friends, things get messy when a strange encounter hints at something darker. What starts as a desperate chase for a girl becomes a tough journey inward--where he learns the hardest person to understand isn't someone else, but himself.

titles.title: Fito Páez: The World Within a Song
titles.synopsis: A documentary film that observes, listens to, and interacts with Fito Páez from a place of profound intimacy. The camera, almost invisible, witnesses his every move, accompanying him for over a year during recordings, rehearsals, tours, and performances in major cities across Latin America, Europe, and the United States. It is also a journey through the life of one of the greatest Spanish-language artists: his loves and heartbreaks, children and friendships, excesses, tragedies, failures, and successes.

titles.title: Famous Last Words: Gloria Steinem
titles.synopsis: Before her death, activist Gloria Steinem shared her final, heartfelt message with the world, knowing this interview would not air until she was gone.

titles.title: Fall 2: Deadpoint
titles.synopsis: On a perilous climb across Thailand's Mount Kwan, two climbers become trapped thousands of feet above the ground, where vertigo-inducing heights, sheer exposure, and impossible odds turn every moment into a fight for survival.

titles.title: Katy Perry: The Lifetimes Tour – Live from Paris
titles.synopsis: Capturing Katy Perry’s electrifying, immersive concert experience, Katy Perry: The Lifetimes Tour – Live from Paris blends powerhouse performances, exhilarating cinematography, and intimate moments to bring audiences into the spectacular world of this creative artist.

titles.title: LEGO Star Wars: The Mandalorian
titles.synopsis: The Mandalorian and Grogu join their misfit allies for an epic party, celebrating their heroism. As friends regale the crowd with tales of their adventures, a pirate threat looms.

titles.title: Turning Point: Generation 9/11
titles.synopsis: A quarter-century after September 11th, the attacks' ripple effects persist across generations. Orphaned children, War on Terror journalists, young Afghans, and U.S. Marines shaped by the 2021 withdrawal share their stories.

titles.title: Infectious
titles.synopsis: During the Black Death, a hunted peasant named Frost fights to survive across plague-ravaged medieval England after a forbidden affair with a nobleman's daughter sparks betrayal, paranoia, and deadly pursuit.

titles.title: Lovesick
titles.synopsis: Set during the Mexican Revolution, follow Emilia Sauri, a woman torn between two passionate loves while navigating a world dominated by violence and revolution.

titles.title: Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu Official Podcast
titles.synopsis: Stream the official podcast for Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu

titles.title: Kalari Kid – She Hits Back
titles.synopsis: In a society marked by gendered violence, nine-year-old Arushi and Milena, twenty-one, reclaim space through Kalari—the world’s oldest martial art. The film follows their fight for self-empowerment and the freedom to be the women they chose to be.

titles.title: Last Reckoning
titles.synopsis: Despite his best efforts to stay away from crime while he's out on parole, Dan's life takes a turn when a duffel bag full of cash meant for gangsters is mistakenly placed in his trunk. With the help of his eccentric friend, he has to choose whether to return the money to keep his family and friends safe, or to run and save himself.

titles.title: Untold Raygun: Breaking Badly
titles.synopsis: Nobody, least of all Rachael Gunn, expected to be an Olympian. But as Raygun’s performance at the 2024 Paris Olympics went viral overnight, so did an avalanche of memes, misinformation, and conspiracy theories questioning how she ever got there.

titles.title: Jared Freid: The Family Plan
titles.synopsis: The special finds Freid keeping his issues “in the family,” joking about everything from vacationing with his parents to a Karen video that hits close to home.

titles.title: 9/11: United We Stand -- 25 Years Later
titles.synopsis: Explore how sports, music, Broadway and comedy helped Americans rediscover joy and begin to heal in the wake of the 9/11 attacks.

titles.title: The Varnell Hill Show
titles.synopsis: Follow Varnell Hill as he fights to stay relevant in a rapidly changing entertainment landscape. Between network executives eager to modernize the show, a chaotic writers' room, celebrity guests, family drama, and his own outsized ego, Varnell quickly discovers that keeping a television empire together may be harder than building one in the first place.

titles.title: Welcome to the Family: The Murder of Dan Markel
titles.synopsis: How far would you go for your family? The brutal murder of a prominent law professor in Tallahassee, Florida reveals the dark secrets of a wealthy family. A series of larger-than-life suspects leads to a mind-bending story of a murder-for-hire-plot, a messy custody battle, ex-lovers – and family dentistry. With exclusive access to those at the center of this extraordinary story, many of whom have never spoken before, this is the definitive telling of a case which took 11 years to solve.

titles.title: The Last Blossom
titles.synopsis: An elderly inmate serving a life sentence awaits a lonely death in solitary—until a voice calls out to him. It belongs to a balsam flower, Housenka, that speaks like a human. Through their 'conversation', the old man reflects on the life he's led.

titles.title: Alien Heart
titles.synopsis: Miles and Ravi house sit a NASA exobiologist mansion, while running astronomy club sign ups, they discover a runaway alien on a ticking cosmic clock, bullies, and crushes that turn their summer into chaos and adventure.

titles.title: NXT Heatwave 2026
titles.synopsis: The 2026 NXT Heatwave was a professional wrestling television special and livestreaming event produced by WWE. It was the fifth annual Heatwave produced by WWE for its developmental brand NXT and the 12th Heatwave overall. The event took place on Sunday, August 30, 2026, at Bert Ogden Arena in Edinburg, Texas, United States - right after Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide's Ola de Calor event in the same venue.

titles.title: Plonternish
titles.synopsis: Eli writes a play.

titles.title: Call My Agent! The Movie
titles.synopsis: Five years after ASK Agency closed, debut director Andréa loses her lead actor just days before filming and reunited with her old team — for better or worse.

titles.title: LEATHERBACK
titles.synopsis: In 1994, a college film crew began documenting two promising physics students, Yulon Ackster and Anthony Schmitt, as they claimed to have cracked the code of controlling time itself. The project was expunged following a terrorist attack in Melbourne, Florida. This is the unsealed footage of what they found.

titles.title: Four Hands, Two Sonatas
titles.synopsis: When two young pianists from completely different worlds meet at an elite music high school, the melodies of their lives become intimately intertwined.

titles.title: The Salt Path
titles.synopsis: The profound story of husband and wife Raynor and Moth Winn, who embark on a 630-mile trek after being forcibly removed from their home. Hoping that in nature they will find solace and a sense of acceptance, they walk through the beautiful but rugged coastlines of South West England - a journey that is exhilarating, challenging, and liberating in equal measure. THE SALT PATH is a powerful portrayal of home, and how it can be lost and rediscovered in the most unexpected ways.

titles.title: Coyote vs. Acme
titles.synopsis: After Acme products fail him one too many times in his dogged pursuit of the Roadrunner, Wile E. Coyote decides to hire a billboard lawyer to sue the Acme Corporation.

titles.title: Hi!
titles.synopsis: Two individuals initially exchange a simple "Hi," but through a series of chance encounters, shared experiences, and deep conversations, they gradually develop a strong connection and eventually fall in love.

titles.title: Once More
titles.synopsis: Raghu, a man caught up with a deep hold of grief comes across Anjali, who is spinning everything in her capacity to win him over. The love you gave away always comes back they say. In one way or other. Sometimes from a different human. This is a story of love coming back into the life of someone who doesn’t want to take it. A tale of second chances.. happy healing and bitter sweet closures.

titles.title: Finding Emily
titles.synopsis: When a lovesick musician is given the wrong number for his dream girl, he teams up with a driven psychology student to find her. Together, they spark a hilarious campus-wide frenzy that tests their own hearts and ambitions along the way.

titles.title: Your's Sincerely RAAM
titles.synopsis: Upcoming Kannada Film

titles.title: Maya Satya Bhram
titles.synopsis: Two disappearances unsettle Kolkata’s Prafullanagar: Totoro, the young son of Sub-Inspector Sanjay Konar, and Sara Nilson, a Swedish researcher studying shamans. Their fates intertwine around one enigmatic man, Trilokdarshi Baba. Once known as Tilu, a boy haunted by violence and visions of death, Trilok grows into a mystic who seems to perceive the boundaries between the living and the beyond. As Sanjay’s search unfolds, the line between truth and faith begins to dissolve.

titles.title: Colony
titles.synopsis: Professor Se-jeong is thrust into a bloody nightmare when a rapidly mutating virus is released during a biotech conference causing authorities to seal the facility. Trapped inside with no escape, Se-jeong along with a small group of survivors must fight to stay alive while the infected undergo horrific transformations.

titles.title: The Dog Stars
titles.synopsis: After the world's population has been ravaged by a pandemic, a man lives a lonesome existence in a Colorado airplane hangar with his dog and a dour gunman he has befriended. When a mysterious transmission comes through on the radio while he’s flying his old Cessna, it sparks a hunt for the provenance of the sound.

titles.title: Filipiñana
titles.synopsis: While working at an elite country club outside Manila, a 17-year-old Ilocana worker uncovers the violent truths of her workplace, her country, and her own past after attempting to return a lost golf club to the club's president.

titles.title: Barreda
titles.synopsis: A fictionalized drama film based on one of the most shocking crimes in Argentina's history. In 1992, Ricardo Barreda was an unassuming dentist, brutally murdered his wife, mother-in-law, and two adult daughters in their family home. Branding himself as a victim, Ricardo Barreda ignited a media storm and fueled a national scandal.

titles.title: Beyond Belief
titles.synopsis: An aspiring teenage rock star trains for a marathon after hearing a mysterious voice.

titles.title: Just Play Dead
titles.synopsis: A criminal mastermind plans to fake his death for insurance money while framing his wife's lover. His wife plots to kill him for real and take it all. Both race to outmanoeuvre each other in a deadly battle of wits.

titles.title: The Sun Never Sets
titles.synopsis: Wendy’s life is thrown into chaos when her boyfriend, Jack, who is older and divorced with children, insists they take space to evaluate the relationship. During their break, Wendy runs into her ex, Chuck, forcing them into a volatile triangle.

titles.title: Buddy
titles.synopsis: A magical, singing orange unicorn holds his cast hostage in a surreal TV-show dimension, as he becomes more and more demented.

titles.title: Boorman and the Devil
titles.synopsis: Featuring commentary from surviving participants, as well as other filmmakers and critics, this documentary chronicles the career of director John Boorman and the tumultuous production of his film Exorcist II: The Heretic, exploring its critical and commercial failure, how it changed the industry, and the importance of risk-taking in art.

titles.title: The Last Scene
titles.synopsis: Selen is a woman with the extraordinary ability to foresee other people’s futures in her dreams. Determined to use this gift to change her own life and the fate of those around her, she unexpectedly finds herself drawn into a dangerous love story. When she crosses paths with Kemal, their connection sparks both passion and peril, forcing Selen to make choices that will shape both of their destinies.

titles.title: The Secret Woman
titles.synopsis: After discovering she has a family and a shipping empire, a woman with amnesia returns to a wealthy and seemingly perfect past to uncover why she left.

titles.title: Baggo
titles.synopsis: Directed by Baljit Singh Deo

titles.title: 32 Frames: A 9/11 Mystery
titles.synopsis: A journalist receives 32 new photos of 9/11 from a camera found in the rubble of the World Trade Center — and uses clues in each frame to ID the photographer.

titles.title: Slick II
titles.synopsis: Months after escaping the cops, Slick has been doing his best to take care of his family. But when the original owner of the gold chain tracks him down and takes his sister hostage, Slick finds himself on another job to retrieve what has already been stolen.

titles.title: Kiku Chiranjeevi
titles.synopsis: A young man named Chiru, born with dextrocardia-a rare condition where his heart is on the right side of his chest faces struggles and challenges as he works to overcome his condition and achieve his goals.

titles.title: Tom & Cherry
titles.synopsis: When Tom suddenly disappears, a mysterious man named Cheer becomes part of an extraordinary journey that no one sees coming. Packed with laughter, emotions, unexpected twists, and heartwarming moments, Tom and Cherry is a wholesome family entertainer that celebrates the true meaning of love and togetherness.

titles.title: Echo Point
titles.synopsis: A man inherits a secluded cabin from his estranged father. Inside, he discovers an old radio emitting strange, eerie signals. As he begins to unravel the truth, he realises the voices on the other end belong to the victims of a killer.

titles.title: Mahaprabhu Jagannath
titles.synopsis: In Kaliyug, the evil asur Aham traps devotees in a mercury-made world, but their faith in Jagannath never breaks. Guided by young Balram's devotion, Mahaprabhu Jagannath defeats Aham through divine wisdom and frees all, proving that true bhakti always triumphs over ego.

titles.title: Idiots
titles.synopsis: Two rock-bottom drivers transport a wealthy teen to rehab, but their simple job spirals into a chaotic journey of drugs, danger, and crime as their passenger derails their plans.

titles.title: Legend of the White Dragon
titles.synopsis: Forced to hide in the shadows, fugitive hero Erik Reed must clear his name to reunite with his family. Standing in his way is a mysterious villain obsessed with destroying the White Dragon for good.

titles.title: The Producer
titles.synopsis: A reckless young graduate becomes the assistant to a demanding music producer, and their clashes turn into an unlikely partnership as they take on the music industry's biggest challenges.

titles.title: Mousetrap
titles.synopsis: A reclusive writer wakes to find his identity stolen — and must ally with a ruthless loan shark to reclaim his life from a man known as "The Rat."

titles.title: All the Truth in My Lies
titles.synopsis: Two roommates join a bachelorette road trip, where unspoken feelings ignite and shake up their entire friend group.

titles.title: Gang War Oslo
titles.synopsis: An inside look at Norway's criminal landscape since the 1980s -- as told by those who ruled the streets and lived to share their stories.

titles.title: Still Water
titles.synopsis: The small town of Wari Pasop appears peaceful, but beneath the calm exterior hides dark secrets. Years earlier, the unexplained disappearance of a woman set off a chain of events leading to a complex series of murders and a race to uncover a well-buried truth.

titles.title: Part-Timers
titles.synopsis: Two roommates, worlds apart, barely stay together. But these two women share one grand dream: a start-up.

titles.title: The Whisper Man
titles.synopsis: When his young son vanishes, a widower enlists help from his estranged father, a retired detective who put away the serial killer now linked to the case.

titles.title: Dalliance
titles.synopsis: Billy, a former cameraman, encounters Dani on a Sydney Harbour ferry as their different worlds intersect.

titles.title: Countdown to Avengers: Doomsday Official Podcast
titles.synopsis: Iman Vellani and Frank Alvarez host a rewatch of films from Marvel Studios' The Infinity Saga, working their way to Avengers: Doomsday. Together, they revisit each film with a recap and a conversation about which themes and characters may continue to have future implications.

titles.title: Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-ups
titles.synopsis: A powerful drug cartel pulls the strings behind a facade of sun-soaked beaches as a gritty, violent underworld power struggle emerges during the crumbling of Portuguese colonial rule.

titles.title: The Last Sunrise
titles.synopsis: Ry, a college student with a chronic illness, escapes to Mallorca for the summer with her mother, where she unexpectedly falls for a local and begins to embrace living in the moment. But as her condition worsens and long-hidden family secrets come to light, everything she has found before summer's end is threatened.

titles.title: 2 Big to Rig
titles.synopsis: Captured live over the course of GHOST’s two sold-out shows in Mexico City last year, 2 BIG TO RIG is the definitive document of the band's unforgettable SKELETOUR WORLD TOUR, presented in IMAX® in select locations.  Featuring the only pro-shot footage of Papa V Perpetua and his band of Nameless Ghouls from the phone-free SKELETOUR, 2 BIG TO RIG immerses the audience in the GHOST live ritual, including exclusive behind-the-scenes and backstage access.

titles.title: Yellow Mirror
titles.synopsis: A defective lamp reveals a heartbreaking truth about what Homer believes is reality, and an AI-powered tablet befriends and controls Maggie. The Simpsons struggle to find the light through two dark tales of the curious and bizarre.

titles.title: The Last Salute
titles.synopsis: Chronicles the MiG-21's final chapter in the Indian Air Force, showcasing stories of generations of fighter pilots who flew it.

titles.title: Dolly: An NBC News Special
titles.synopsis: A look back at Dolly Parton's remarkable journey to stardom, her groundbreaking career and her lasting impact far beyond music.

titles.title: Starting Towards the Finish Line
titles.synopsis: Ever since his mother moved to the city for work, Xiaoqing, who has lost his father, has had a dream: he too wants to go to the Lotus City. After many setbacks, his goal seems out of reach. But when he finds an old, rusty car in the reeds, he finds new hope: will he and his friends make it to the city?

titles.title: My Name Is Gutierrez
titles.synopsis: Deputy Commissioner Gutierrez competes with the CIA to solve the murder of the Russian Ambassador with his unique style.

titles.title: The Early Spring
titles.synopsis: New to Beijing, Shang Zhitao crosses paths with Luan Nian, a true creative genius. Bold and open-hearted, she grows stronger step by step and gradually breaks through the defenses around Luan's guarded heart. Drawn to each other, they find themselves caught in an intense, on-again, off-again relationship in the urban jungle. To love is to summon all your courage and leave no regrets, to heal each other, and to grow together. But when love and her career pull her in different directions, she puts her career first. When she has come into her own and he has learned to soften his sharp edges, they finally stand as equals, ready to write a new ending together...

titles.title: The Airport Chaplain
titles.synopsis: Airport Chaplain Tobias Wallace is convinced the airport couldn’t possibly run without his 24/7 devotion. But new Terminal Manager Mira Ansari-Cole is convinced he’s a walking liability.

titles.title: Totally '90s House
titles.synopsis: Follows two teams of '90s television idols with a passion for design and renovation as they scour the country for houses stuck in the 1990s - think honey oak cabinets, sponge-painted walls and mirrored closets - with each team ultimately picking their perfect throwback in need of a major overhaul.

titles.title: Wishbone Kitchen
titles.synopsis: Pull up a kitchen stool and press play. Each week, Meredith Hayden — the voice behind Wishbone Kitchen — sits down to talk cozy, crave-worthy recipes, real kitchen tips, and the small rituals that turn a house into a home. It's the kind of podcast that makes you want to light a candle, pour a glass of wine, and press record on your own kitchen story.

titles.title: Death of the Pastor's Wife
titles.synopsis: What happened to Mica Miller? This documentary series retraces her promising life, toxic marriage and the mysterious circumstances of her death.

titles.title: Mom Knows Best?
titles.synopsis: Nine mothers compete to prove they know their children best; they wager money on predicting their children's choices and discover that their children can still surprise them.

titles.title: Plan Bea
titles.synopsis: Bea has always known she was born to perform. But when a pandemic shuts down her school's music program and bans singing altogether, even her boundless ambition hits a wall. Undeterred, she convinces her friends to form an underground show choir — and what starts as an act of rebellion slowly becomes something much bigger: a reminder that music isn't a privilege, it's a lifeline. Funny, heartfelt, and packed with original songs, Plan Bea is an Australian musical feature film that proves you can't stop joy.

titles.title: Untold: The Testimony of Vince Young
titles.synopsis: After delivering one of the greatest performances in Rose Bowl history, Texas Longhorns legend Vince Young was the NFL's next big thing, and for a while, he was. But a career riddled by injuries, conflict and sudden loss tells a far more complicated story than the highlight reels ever showed.

titles.title: Stamptown
titles.synopsis: Blending the wild worlds of circus and comedy, anarchic acts collide for this raunchy and explicit variety show - clothing not guaranteed.

titles.title: Pickleballers
titles.synopsis: When Max Dangerfield's anger issues get her strapped with $25,000 in fines, she's completely lost on how to dig herself out.  Luckily, her two best friends Charlotte and Spence have an idea. The internet show sensation 'Balloon Shop' is having a pickleball tournament with a huge cash prize. The only problem - none of them know what pickleball is.  With an array of unhinged new friends support, Max and her new partner Lexi are ready to take it all on. The only wall in their way is Rachel Summers. The token town mean girl with a vendetta aimed right at Max's forehead.  Rachel hires a 5 time tournament winning pickleball player as her partner to ensure Max and Lexi stand no chance at all.  So, with the odds stacked against them the gang have no choice but to give it everything they've got.

titles.title: Dolly Parton: An American Original – Special Edition of 20/20
titles.synopsis: Celebrating Dolly Parton's life, music and legacy -- featuring never-before-seen interviews with Dolly herself, unforgettable interviews with Robin Roberts and Barbara Walters, and reflections from those who knew her best.

titles.title: Spark
titles.synopsis: An investigative journalist takes on a massive bank scam, challenging a powerful cop—and soon uncovers a deadly conspiracy that leads straight to its hidden mastermind.

titles.title: Anchorage Point
titles.synopsis: World renown architect struggles with the weight of his failed bridge design and the lives it claimed

titles.title: Oozhi
titles.synopsis: After two years apart, Lenin and Megha unexpectedly meet at a stargazing camp. When Lenin discovers an alien stone that takes him back into the memories and guilt of their past, he sees a chance to fix what he broke.

titles.title: The Great American Journey
titles.synopsis: The Great American Journey will travel the country celebrating American history and exploring the people, places and ideas that have shaped our nation. The series will examine how the American story continues to evolve and the role each generation plays in defining what comes next.

titles.title: The Marching Band
titles.synopsis: A world-famous orchestra conductor discovers the brother he never knew he had — a school cafeteria worker who plays trombone in a local marching band. Detecting his brother's exceptional musical talent, he takes it upon himself to rectify the injustice of fate.

titles.title: The Magic Faraway Tree
titles.synopsis: A modern family relocates to the countryside where the children discover a magical tree with eccentric residents. They're transported to fantastical lands, rekindling their family bond through adventures.
